title: Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.22583v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deploy

translated_title: 面向延迟与模型大小优化的大语言模型多目标结构化剪枝
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.22583v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）因其强大的推理和问答能力而得到了广泛应用。然而，由于严格的延迟、内存和能耗限制，将其部署到嵌入式和边缘计算环境中仍然充满挑战。其庞大的参数量和计算需求阻碍了在资源受限平台上的高效执行。尽管模型剪枝已成为在保持性能的同时缩减模型规模的一种可行方案，但联合优化层数、注意力头数以及多层感知机（MLP）维度仍然极为复杂。穷举探索这一组合设计空间的计算开销巨大，且往往导致局部最优或不稳定的配置。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架。所提出的两阶段方法明确地以延迟和模型大小为目标，以实现高效部署（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架，通过两阶段方法联合优化大语言模型的层数、注意力头和MLP维度，以同时最小化延迟和模型大小，从而实现边缘设备上的高效部署。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework that uses a two-stage method to jointly optimize layers, attention heads, and MLP dimensions of LLMs, targeting both latency and model size for efficient edge deployment.
